ov: السمكري الخياط الجندي الجاسوس (الإنجليزية: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy) فيلم بريطاني مأخوذ من رواية بنفس الاسم للكاتب جون لو كاريه صدرت الرواية عام 1974، الفيلم من إخراج توماس الفريدسون فاز الفيلم بجائزة الأكاديمية البريطانية لفنون السينما والتلفزيون عن جائزة أفضل فيلم بريطاني عام 2012.
plotEn:
In 1973, "Control", head of British intelligence ("The Circus"), sends Jim Prideaux to Budapest to meet a Hungarian general who has the name of a mole at the top of British Intelligence. Prideaux realises the meeting is a trap, but is shot as he tries to flee. Control and his right-hand man, George Smiley, are forced to retire, and Control dies soon after. Sir Percy Alleline becomes the new Chief, with Bill Haydon, Roy Bland, and Toby Esterhase the other remaining Circus leaders. The four had already begun receiving Soviet intelligence from a secret source (Operation "Witchcraft").
Field agent Ricki Tarr warns Permanent Undersecretary Oliver Lacon that there is a mole among the Circus leadership. Knowing that Control had the same theory, Lacon asks Smiley to investigate, and he agrees on the condition that Tarr's boss Peter Guillam and retired Special Branch officer Mendel join the investigation. Guillam obtains personnel and financial records from the Circus showing that staff loyal to Control had been forced out, and Smiley interviews analyst Connie Sachs, who was sacked after deducing that Soviet cultural attaché Alexei Polyakov was a military officer and suspecting he was running a mole in London.
